title: Canonical etale derived internal-Hom pullback comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $g:X'\to X$ a morphism of schemes, and $K,M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ in the ordinary unbounded etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $H_X=R\mathcal Hom_A$ with its derived tensor-Hom adjunction [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], use the derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor], write $g^*$ for the exact constant-coefficient inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and its derived functor, and let $\alpha:g^*(F\otimes_A^L G)\xrightarrow{\sim}g^*F\otimes_A^L g^*G$ be the inverse of the canonical bifunctorial comparison isomorphism $g^*F\otimes_A^L g^*G\to g^*(F\otimes_A^L G)$ of [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal] (the case of the ringed topoi morphism induced by $g$ with constant coefficients). Define $\beta_{K,M}:g^*H_X(K,M)\to H_{X'}(g^*K,g^*M)$ as the transpose under the derived tensor-Hom adjunction of $g^*K\otimes_A^L g^*H_X(K,M)\xrightarrow{\alpha^{-1}}g^*(K\otimes_A^L H_X(K,M))\xrightarrow{g^*\mathrm{ev}_{K,M}}g^*M$. This defines the evaluation-induced comparison for arbitrary $K,M$, without regularity, boundedness, constructibility or invertibility assumptions.

def etaleInternalHomPullbackComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (K M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj
        (((RHom(X)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (op K)).obj M) ⟶
      ((RHom(X')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
        (op ((L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj K))).obj
        ((L((g)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])).obj M)
